item.title: Elasticsearch cluster network and indexes
item.description: Elasticsearch is a distributed search engine: clients speak HTTP, nodes form a TCP mesh, a master publishes ClusterState, and each data node stores Lucene-backed shard copies. This post covers cluster management (topology and TCP transport) and how an index is modeled and opened, from the tree under git/elasticsearch (server Version.CURRENT = 9.6.0 on main).

item.title: Lucene internals
item.description: Apache Lucene is the Java library behind each Elasticsearch shard’s on-disk store. This post walks how a Lucene index is laid out—segments, index types, and the in-memory reader—then runs a concrete query example: filter by created_date, aggregate qty. Grounded in git/lucene (Version.LATEST = 11.0.0, default write codec Lucene104; points remain Lucene90 / BKD).
